crosswalks.resolution_method: Selected the five EU5 locations with province=norfolk_province. The historical area is reconstructed from Campbell's mean 1290 population and 168 people per square mile; the declared 0.978 coverage absorbs the county-envelope discrepancy without rescaling the target.

area_comparison.area_method: Campbell 2008 table 14 density-derived historical area versus calibrated EU5 area
area_comparison.area_difference_policy: Retain the declared 0.978 crosswalk confidence; do not inflate or deflate population.

crosswalks.notes: County selector is exact in EU5 administrative metadata, but this remains validation-only because the population methods are conditional and no capacity interval is published.

crosswalks.resolution_method: Selected the six EU5 locations with province=lincolnshire_province. area_comparison.area_method: Campbell 2008 table 14 density-derived historical area versus calibrated EU5 area
